rows.text: calls `0017F5B0(1)` when dword `022BE970` is non-zero, then for each of the first dword `02EBCBC0` qwords of the array at `02EBCAC0` (the count re-read after each call) calls `002EB030(entry, 0x1049)` on the non-null ones

for each of the first dword `02EBCC60` qwords of the array at `02EBCAC0` that is non-null, calls the entry's record lookup (the direct call at + 0x3C) and, when that returns a record, `0026B720(00263F40(entry), float +0x10, float +0x14, float +0x18 of the record)`

corrections.why: the record lookup is named by role: its address pulled a caller edge from another layer into the page (nb_page)
